FAQs

Is registration free?

Yes. Entry is free. Registration is, however, mandatory.

Is registration compulsory?

Yes. You need to register to attend.

Who can attend?

Newly joined medical students of the batch 2026.

What is the purpose of the event?

To appreciate your achievements and help you begin your MBBS journey with proper guidance.
With a headstart.

What should I expect?

Guidance from practicing doctors and seniors, networking, stalls, and free food.

Where and when is it?

1 November, 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Venue: Sapphire Function Palace, Malakpet
